title: 第5章 前辈洞府
content_zh:
“我把你们召集过来可不是让你们来吵架的！”海无涯的冷喝声在整个大厅内游荡，海家众人一个个都战战兢兢，谁也不敢发出半点的声音，生怕惹恼了海无涯。

见众人都沉默了下来，海无涯扫视了一眼，咳嗽了一声这才说道：“其实这次把你们都叫过来，是有一件大事要宣布。”

“大事？”无论是海天还是小雨等人心中都泛起了一丝疑惑。

海无涯并没有要卖关子的意思，接下去说道：“我和二弟三弟以及三位长老将要离开，在我们不在的这段时间内，海家的一切都由管家负责，你们都不准懈怠，必须努力的修炼。”

“是！”众人心中一惊，海家的高手竟然全部离开。

“父亲，你们都离开了，要是撒鲁家族以及李家来偷袭怎么办？”海云忽然说道。

撒鲁家族以及李家是黑石城三大家族中的另外两大家族，实力和海家差不多。这么多年来三家表面看上去很平静，但是暗地里的争斗一直都没有停止过。

听了海云的疑问，海无涯笑了笑：“云儿，你放心好了。撒鲁家族以及李家的高层都将和我们一起离开，你们完全不用担心了。对了，你和我们几个人一起去。”

“这是真的吗？那太好了。”海云兴奋的跳了起来，他虽然不知道这回出去的目的，但是能海无涯他们一同出去，这就足以说明了他在这海家的地位了。

兴奋的同时，海云还挑衅的瞥了几眼海天以及小雨，一副小人得志的样子。众人都羡慕的望着海云，多么期望海云就是他们自己。

“哼！天哥，这个家伙太嚣张了。不就是能和大伯他们一起出去吗？得意什么？”小雨很是不服气的低声说道。

海天倒是毫不在意，用他自己的话说，去海云攀比，那是自降身价。他心中真正好奇的是黑石城三大家族高层为何在这个时间一起离开？

见一切都已经安排完毕，坐在首位的海无涯和三位长老互相点头示意，便立即让众人全部回去了，继续他们原先所做的事情。只是海无涯却让海云和海天两个人留下了。

“小雨，你先回去吧，我一会儿就来。”见小雨那恋恋不舍的样子，海天吩咐了一句。

这下，小雨才默默的点了点头，恨恨的瞪了一眼得意的海云离开了。

不一会儿，大厅内的众人已经全部走光了，只剩下海天他们了。

“天儿，这回我们可能要出去很长一段时间，你要好好修炼。切忌，千万不要去修炼那本《九天神剑诀》，它是不会给你带来强大的实力的。”海无涯眼神里充满了关切，看得一旁的海云心中十分的嫉妒。

旁边的一位长老猛然睁开了眼睛，惊道：“什么？海天选择了《九天神剑诀》？”

“是啊，我也不知道这小子怎么会选上这部功法的。不过我已经嘱咐他重新选择了一部黄阶高级的功法了。”海无涯的脸上也是带了一丝苦涩。

望了一眼那位长老，海天奇道：“请问长老大人，海家的前辈们在修炼这部《九天神剑诀》的时候是在什么时候凝聚出剑灵的呢？”

“剑灵？他们都一直没有达到过一星剑士，怎么可能会凝聚出剑灵？天儿，你怎么会这么问？”回答这话的并不是先前的那位长老，而是另外一位慈眉善目的老者。海天心中清楚，这老者正是海家的大长老，也是海家的第一高手，比他父亲还要强上几分。

只是大长老的话却让他心中一阵突兀，那些前辈们居然都没有凝聚出剑灵，可他现在却凝聚出剑灵来了，这到底是怎么回事？

内视了一下，海天发现自己体内的那柄半透明的小剑依然悬挂在丹田上方，丹田内那由乳白色剑灵力形成的漩涡正不断的快速运转着，一丝丝白色的气流被上方的剑灵吸入了进去。一切都很正常，唯一不正常的便是他现在才只有一段剑之力而已。

才刚开始修炼，他就已经和过去那些修炼《九天神剑诀》的人不一样了，那么他还能够成为一名正式剑者吗？

海天的心中充满了疑惑，可要是让他就这样放弃的话太不甘心了。虽然是残缺的，这毕竟是天阶级别的功法。

“那些前辈们一直无法达到一星剑士，随后也就转修别的功法了。只可惜他们的天赋仿佛在这《九天神剑诀》上挥霍掉了，之后也没有太大的起色。”最早说话的那位长老也是叹息一声，流露出浓浓的惋惜。

“对了，天儿，你怎么会这么问？”海无涯敏锐的察觉到海天的奇怪，立即询问道。

“没，没什么，我只是好奇。”海天摇了摇脑袋，他可不想让海无涯知道自己已经开始修炼了这部天阶功法。

“哼！就凭他的实力，给他三年也无法凝聚出剑灵来！”修炼了三年才六段剑之力的海云不屑的冷哼了一声，他才不会相信海天的天赋比他还要好。

对于海云的话，海天完全无视了。在上一世中，他也仅花了一年半的时间便从一段剑之力修炼到了一星剑士，有过一世经验的他，还会花三年以上的时间？笑话！

紧接着他便将目光放到了海无涯身上：“父亲，你们这次出去到底要做什么？怎么连其他两大家族的高层一起离开了？”

“呵呵，告诉你也无妨。撒鲁家族的一名子弟在黑石城旁的七品山脉里发现了一个山洞，而这个山洞有着很多的机关防御，可能是一位前辈高人遗留下的洞府。撒鲁家族立即组织人马前去探查，只可惜损失巨大，却依然没有进入洞府的真正核心。随后他们便邀请我们另外两大家族的高手一同前去，洞府里的东西各凭本事。”海无涯笑呵呵的说出了他们这次的目的。

海天听了心中便是明了了几分，这种前辈高人遗留下来的洞府在魂剑大陆上数不胜数，他自己也遗留下来了一个洞府，只可惜那里布置的可是禁制，没有剑圣以上级别的实力是无法破解的，不然他早就去将自己的东西拿回来了。

“原来是这样，不过父亲你们就这样倾巢而出，万一这是撒鲁家族的诡计怎么办？”海天沉吟了一会儿便提出了疑问，他可不想自己这个栖身之地被别人毁掉。

“不错，你能够想到这点证明脑袋不错。其实我们原本也是这样怀疑的，可是撒鲁家族给我们看了一样东西，我们便不再怀疑了。”海无涯赞赏的点了点头，很显然海天能够想到这点让他十分的满意。

边上的海云见海无涯一直对海天如此的温和，心中是越发的嫉妒了，忽然插嘴道：“父亲，是什么东西？”

大长老捋了捋花白的胡子，笑了笑：“是一件黄阶高级的剑器！”

“黄阶高级的剑器！”海天诧异的挑了挑眉毛，显得十分的惊讶。海无涯等人都很满意海云的表情，当初他们也都和海云差不多。

要知道在这魂剑大陆上，剑者使用的兵器被称为剑器，大多是长剑，而这剑器也是分等级的。

和剑灵一样，分为天，地，玄，黄四阶，每一阶又分为初级，中级以及高级。这下海天总算明白了，也难怪海家会如此的动心，剑器在整个魂剑大陆上十分的难得。

普通的剑者恐怕连剑器都没有，即使是一名剑师能有一柄黄阶初级的剑器就相当不错了。海天自己当初使用的也只不过是一柄地阶初级的剑器而已。

一个仅在外围便存放了一把黄阶高级剑器的洞府，傻瓜都知道意味着什么。

“父亲，不知道你能不能带我去？”海天也心动了，说不定那个洞府的核心范围内，有玄阶甚至更加高级的剑器存在呢。

他的灵魂来到了海天身体内，可曾经用过的那柄地阶初级的剑器却没了。在弱肉强食的魂剑大陆上，有一柄好的剑器，可以增强许多的战斗力。

“不行，你还没有开始修炼，那个地方相当的危险，我们自保都尚且不足，怎么可能分心来保护你？”想都没想，海无涯就拒绝了海天的提议，“之所以带云儿去，主要是想带他见识一下外面的世界。等将来你和云儿实力差不多了，我们也会带你出去的。”

“是啊！海天，你就好好的留在家里看家吧，千万别给老管家添太多的麻烦哟。”海云心中十分的得意，他还是第一次感觉如此的爽快，能够让海天吃憋。

如果不是海无涯以及几位长老在的话，他真想大笑三声！

完全无视了海云的冷嘲热讽，海天低下了脑袋，他很不情愿就这样放弃，说不定那个洞府里还隐藏着其他令人心动的宝贝呢。

“天儿，你大哥说得对，你先好好的修炼吧，日后有的是机会。”海无涯察觉到了海天眼神里的失落，赶忙安慰了几句。

“是，父亲，那我现在便告退了。”自知不会再有机会，海天也不再继续磨蹭，立即退了下去。

可眼神里却是闪烁着一丝倔强的光芒：“你们不带我去？我自己去！”

PS：粉嫩新人冲榜求推荐票，麻烦各位书友砸点吧
content_en:
"I didn't call you here just to quarrel!" Hai Wuya's cold shouts circulated throughout the hall. Everyone in the Hai family was trembling with fear. No one dared to make a sound for fear of offending Hai Wuya.

Seeing that everyone was silent, Hai Wuya glanced around, coughed and then said: "Actually, I have called you all here this time because I have something big to announce."

"A big deal?" Hai Tian, Xiao Yu and others all had doubts in their hearts.

Hai Wuya did not mean to show off, and went on to say: "My second brother, third brother, and three elders are about to leave. During our absence, everything in the Hai family will be in charge of the housekeeper. You are not allowed to slack off, and you must practice hard."

"Yes!" Everyone was shocked, and all the masters of the Hai family left.

"Father, you have all left. What if the Salu family and the Li family come to attack us?" Haiyun said suddenly.

The Salu family and the Li family are the other two major families among the three major families in Black Rock City, and their strength is similar to that of the Hai family.Over the years, the three families have seemed peaceful on the surface, but the fighting has never stopped secretly.

After hearing Hai Yun's question, Hai Wuya smiled and said, "Yun'er, don't worry. The senior leaders of the Salu family and the Li family will leave with us, so you don't have to worry at all. By the way, you go with a few of us."

"Is this true? That's great." Hai Yun jumped up excitedly. Although he didn't know the purpose of going out this time, being able to go out with Hai Wuya and the others was enough to illustrate his status in the Hai family.

While excited, Haiyun also glanced provocatively at Haitian and Xiaoyu, looking like a villain who has succeeded.Everyone looked at Haiyun with envy, hoping that Haiyun would be them.

"Hmph! Brother Tian, ​​this guy is too arrogant. Isn't it just that he can go out with the uncle and the others? What are you proud of?" Xiao Yu whispered unconvinced.

Hai Tian didn't care at all. In his own words, to compare with Hai Yun was to lower one's worth.What he was really curious about was why the top leaders of the three major families in Black Rock City left together at this time?

Seeing that everything had been arranged, Hai Wuya and the three elders, who were sitting at the head, nodded to each other and immediately asked everyone to go back and continue what they were doing.But Hai Wuya let Hai Yun and Hai Tian stay.

"Xiao Yu, you go back first, I'll be back in a moment." Seeing Xiao Yu's reluctant look, Hai Tian ordered.

At this time, Xiao Yu nodded silently, glared at the proud Hai Yun bitterly and left.

After a while, everyone in the hall had disappeared, leaving only Hai Tian and the others.

"Tian'er, we may have to go out for a long time this time. You have to practice well. Don't practice the "Nine Heavens Divine Sword Art". It will not bring you great strength." Hai Wuya's eyes were full of concern, which made Hai Yun who was watching aside feel very jealous.

An elder next to him suddenly opened his eyes and said in shock: "What? Hai Tian chose the "Nine Heavens Divine Sword Art"?"

"Yeah, I don't know how this kid chose this technique. But I have already asked him to choose a high-level Huang-level technique." Hai Wuya also had a trace of bitterness on his face.

Looking at the elder, Hai Tianqi said: "Excuse me, elder, when did the seniors of the Hai family condense the sword spirit when they practiced the "Nine Heavens Divine Sword Art"?"

"Sword Spirit? They have never reached the level of a one-star swordsman. How can they condense a sword spirit? Tian'er, why do you ask this?" The person who answered this was not the previous elder, but another kind-hearted old man.Hai Tian knew clearly in his heart that this old man was the eldest elder of the Hai family and the number one master of the Hai family, even better than his father.

But the words of the great elder made him feel suddenly. None of those seniors had condensed the sword spirit, but now he had condensed the sword spirit. What was going on?

Looking inside, Hai Tian found that the small translucent sword in his body was still hanging above the dantian. The vortex formed by the milky white sword spirit power in the dantian was constantly rotating rapidly, and traces of white air were sucked in by the sword spirit above.Everything is normal, the only abnormal thing is that he only has the power of a sword now.

He has just started practicing, and he is already different from those who practiced the "Nine Heavens Divine Sword Art" in the past. So can he still become an official swordsman?

Hai Tian's heart was full of doubts, but he would be too unwilling to give up like this.Although it is incomplete, this is a heaven-level skill after all.

"Those seniors have never been able to reach the level of a one-star swordsman, and then they switched to other techniques. Unfortunately, their talents seemed to be squandered on the "Nine Heavens Divine Sword Art", and there was not much improvement after that." The elder who spoke first also sighed, showing deep regret.

"By the way, Tian'er, why do you ask that?" Hai Wuya was keenly aware of Hai Tian's strangeness and asked immediately.

"No, it's nothing, I'm just curious." Hai Tian shook his head. He didn't want Hai Wuya to know that he had started practicing this heaven-level technique.

"Hmph! With his strength, he won't be able to condense the sword spirit even if he is given three years!" Hai Yun, who had only been able to practice the sixth level of sword power for three years, snorted disdainfully. He would not believe that Hai Tian's talent was better than his.

Hai Tian completely ignored Hai Yun's words.In his previous life, it only took him a year and a half to train from a level of sword power to a one-star swordsman. With his experience in one life, would it still take him more than three years?joke!

Then he set his sights on Hai Wuya: "Father, what are you going to do when you go out this time? Why did you leave with the top leaders of the other two major families?"

"Haha, it's okay to tell you. A descendant of the Salu family discovered a cave in the Qipin Mountains next to Blackstone City. This cave has many defense mechanisms. It may be a cave left by a senior master. The Salu family immediately organized people.We went to investigate, but it was a pity that we lost a lot of money, but we still didn't get into the real core of the cave.Then they invited the experts from our other two families to go together, and everything in the cave was based on their own abilities." Hai Wuya smiled and said their purpose this time.

After hearing this, Hai Tian understood something in his heart. There are countless caves left by senior masters on the Soul Sword Continent. He himself also left a cave. Unfortunately, the caves there were restricted and could not be broken without the strength of a sword master or above. Otherwise, he would have gone to get his things back.

"So that's it, but father, you all came out like this. What if this is a trick of the Salu family?" Hai Tian pondered for a while and then asked a question. He didn't want his place of residence to be destroyed by others.

"Yes, the fact that you can think of this proves that you have a good head. In fact, we originally suspected this, but the Salu family showed us something, and we no longer doubted it." Hai Wuya nodded appreciatively, and it was obvious that Hai Tian was very satisfied that he could think of this.

Haiyun beside him became more and more jealous when he saw that Hai Wuya had always been so gentle to Haitian. He suddenly interrupted: "Father, what is it?"

The great elder smoothed his gray beard and smiled: "It is a high-end yellow-level sword!"

"A high-end Huang-level sword!" Hai Tian raised his eyebrows in surprise, looking very surprised.Hai Wuya and others were very satisfied with Hai Yun's expression. They were similar to Hai Yun at first.

You must know that in this Soul Sword Continent, the weapons used by swordsmen are called swords. Most of them are long swords, and these swords are also divided into levels.

Like Sword Spirit, it is divided into four levels: Heaven, Earth, Xuan and Huang. Each level is divided into primary, intermediate and advanced levels.Now Hai Tian finally understood. It was no wonder that the Hai family was so tempted. Sword weapons were very rare in the entire Soul Sword Continent.

Ordinary swordsmen probably don't even have swords. Even if a swordsman has a yellow-level sword, it would be quite good.What Hai Tian himself used at the beginning was just a low-level sword.

A cave with a yellow-level high-end sword stored just outside the cave, even a fool knows what it means.

"Father, I wonder if you can take me there?" Hai Tian was also moved. Maybe there are swords of Xuan level or even higher level within the core range of that cave.

His soul came to Hai Tian's body, but the earth-level sword he once used was gone.In the Soul Sword Continent where the weak prey on the strong, having a good sword can enhance a lot of combat effectiveness.

"No, you haven't started practicing yet. That place is quite dangerous. Our self-protection is not enough. How can we be distracted to protect you?" Without even thinking, Hai Wuya rejected Hai Tian's proposal. "The reason why I took Yun'er there is mainly to show him the outside world. When you and Yun'er are almost as strong as each other in the future, we will take you out as well."

"Yes! Hai Tian, just stay at home and take care of the house, and don't cause too much trouble to the old housekeeper." Hai Yun was very proud. This was the first time that he felt so happy that he could hold back Hai Tian.

If Hai Wuya and several elders weren't there, he would really want to laugh three times!

Completely ignoring Hai Yun's cynicism, Hai Tian lowered his head. He was very reluctant to give up like this. Maybe there were other exciting treasures hidden in that cave.

"Tian'er, your elder brother is right. You should practice hard first. There will be many opportunities in the future." Hai Wuya noticed the disappointment in Hai Tian's eyes and quickly comforted him with a few words.

"Yes, father, I will resign now." Knowing that he would not have another chance, Hai Tian stopped lingering and immediately retreated.

But there was a stubborn light in his eyes: "You won't take me there? I'll go by myself!"
